mapper.select: WITH stock_keys AS ( SELECT stock_code, base_date FROM investor_flow_analysis WHERE base_date = #{baseDate} UNION SELECT stock_code, base_date FROM value_fundamental WHERE base_date = #{baseDate} ) SELECT k.base_date, k.stock_code, a.flow_score, v.value_score, v.div_yield, v.value_trap FROM stock_keys k LEFT JOIN investor_flow_analysis a ON a.stock_code = k.stock_code AND a.base_date = k.base_date LEFT JOIN value_fundamental v ON v.stock_code = k.stock_code AND v.base_date = k.base_date
